title: Summer resource.yaml — kind: skill (requires sibling SKILL.md, checked by validate-library)

hosted_resource.description: The skill's current text lives on the hosted Summer Engine MCP as this resource; summer_read_library loads it from there (store sign-in) and falls back to the local SKILL.md.

recommended.description: Installed by `summer skills install --recommended` (and `summer setup`). Omitted means false.
